title: Studio publish refusals: shown only as a ~4 s toast with engine-internal text; the Pending changes panel keeps no refusal; "Show me" does not focus the offending input and the dashboard/report refusal strip has no "Show me"
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

When publish is refused, the reason vanishes after a few seconds, sometimes reads like source code, and the "Show me" affordance lands the builder near — not on — the problem.

## Reproduction

1. Publish a package with an unconfigured summary field → toast for ~4 s with text like "`engine.ts` — `if (!d.summaryOperations) continue`"; Pending changes panel shows no refusal afterwards.
2. Data refusal strip › "Show me" → the inspector opens but `document.activeElement` is the body/button, not the field input.
3. A refused dashboard or report shows a refusal strip without "Show me".

## Expected

The refusal stays visible on the item in Pending changes until fixed, uses author-facing text, and "Show me" focuses the offending input for every item kind.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (~1436-1500 publish result handling, ~6411-6424 Show me, ~4641 leaf strip) and `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Data, Interfaces and Access QA cards.
- Business reason: Refusals are where builders most need guidance; a disappearing, code-shaped message sends them hunting.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio publish refusal only toast engine internal text, Show me does not focus offending input` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 1 hit (closed #10287, a different toast issue).
- QA id: U3
